decision: Keep the existing timing-environment qualification predicate distinct from exhaustive descendant-containment proof. Do not introduce a new privileged observer as a prerequisite or silently claim full process/resource containment.
descendant_containment: unproven, separately retained; no overall or tamper-resistant host certification claimed
optional_privileged_observer: experimental, not admitted; no actual Endpoint Security stream or analyzers were observed
timing_qualification: fresh 300-second >=90% aggregate-idle window before each group
no observed contention during the group
fixed inputs, adapter timing boundaries, preserved case/outcome/config reconciliation and resource/time gates
